 América aim to extend their lead at the top 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Tonight, Club América will face Xolos in a postponed match from Matchday 7 of the Apertura 2026.
 The Eagles head into this game in hand at the top of the standings with 27 points, ahead of Cruz Azul and Chivas, who are one point behind.
 OneFootball Videos
 Now, Guillermo Almada’s side will look to extend their lead to four points with three matchdays remaining for everyone, meaning a win over Xolos could all but secure top spot in the regular season.
 Here is América’s schedule for the final stretch of the tournament. 
 América will close out the tournament with one home match and two away games, wrapping up the regular season in late November.
 Saturday 31 – América vs Toluca – 09:00PM
 Saturday 7 – Pumas vs América – 09:00PM
 Saturday 21 – Tigres vs América – 09:00PM
